name: Bough
author: E. T. Carter
description: The shadow of a potted bough thrown on an insomniac's wall: elliptical leaves hung on curved stems, drawn purely as occlusion of an unseen lamp's glow. Each leaf carries a hashed occluder distance that sets its edge softness, so near leaves bite crisp while far ones swell into soft grey breaths; the cluster pivots in a heater draft and every leaf nods on its own phase, animating the blur itself.

params.label: Sway speed
params.effect: Rate of the cluster pivot and the per-leaf nodding that drives the shadow play.

params.label: Leaf size
params.effect: CSS-pixel length of the leaf ellipses, scaling the whole shadow cluster.

params.label: Penumbra
params.effect: Scales how much each leaf's hashed wall distance blurs its edge, from a uniformly crisp cluster at 0 to far leaves dissolving into breath at 2.

params.label: Pool depth
params.effect: How much darker overlapping soft shadows multiply where leaves cross.
